- **Not checked:** I couldn't see a renewal contract in the shared files, so neither number has been checked against it. I suggested Hollis ask Tobias to confirm before updating the account sheet.
- **Your attention:** My wrap-up notes from the last two turns were posted as channel messages, one in #central-team and one in #central-random. They contain only account details like seat counts, nothing about money. Still, they're notes meant for you, not for the team, and the one in #central-team says the number is 382. You might want to delete them.
